hook: Most holiday shoppers think budgets work, yet only 36% actually stick to them.

sections.voiceover: Most holiday shoppers think budgets work, yet only 36% actually stick to them.
b_roll: Display holiday shopping bags piled high next to a glowing smartphone screen showing a red warning percentage.

text_overlay.text: Only 36% stick to a holiday budget

sections.voiceover: On October 14, 2026, CNBC Select published a new report reviewing holiday budgeting tools. Over two dozen products faced testing for costs and features. Which app costs $14.99 a month?
b_roll: Show a digital calendar flipping to October 14, followed by a lineup of glowing app logos on a sleek desk.

text_overlay.text: CNBC Select reviewed over two dozen products

sections.voiceover: Rocket Money offers a free tier, but its Premium plan costs $7 to $14 a month.
b_roll: Display a mobile screen showing a zero dollar tier upgrade button.

text_overlay.text: Rocket Money premium plan costs up to $14

sections.voiceover: YNAB charges $14.99 a month for zero-based budgeting features. YNAB costs $14.99 a month according to CNBC Select. CNBC Select tested Rocket Money and YNAB to find your best option.
b_roll: Show a price tag ticking up to $14.99 beside a monthly subscription dashboard.

sections.voiceover: Only 36% of holiday shoppers keep their budget.
b_roll: Flash the final percentage statistic on a clean dark background.
